text:
liz: quick fail in docusaurus build: linkcheck complaining about fragment '/reference/cli#install-' (trailing hyphen).

omar: that one's from a heading that ends with an em dash in the source. slugger handles it differently across versions.

liz: simplest fix is explicit id: `### Install — Windows {#install-windows}`. can someone pick a convention?

devex-tom: prefer kebab ids `install-windows`. we should add a short note in docs/style about avoiding punctuation in headings and preferring explicit ids when punctuation is required.

link-bot: scanned repo: 7 headings with terminal punctuation that may create fragile slugs. Logged in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2201

omar: i'll patch the CLI guide and add a tiny script `scripts/find-frag-risk.sh` to list risky headings.

ci-bot: running anchor-lint on PR 2201.

liz: also reminder — after changing ids run `yarn docs:sync` so translations keep stable anchors.

ci-bot: build passed. linkcheck green :white_check_mark:
